notes.title: Patch 0.2 Out
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

New Patch is out. Here are the changes made

1). Fixed some small layout stuff in the beginning based on feedback. 

2). Took out the rain system in Chapter 2 as it wasn't working. 

3). fixed some audio issues in the High Mountains level. More audio fixes coming soon. 

4). Fixed a small cutscene issue with the final battle scene. 

4). MOST IMPORTANTLY: Combat has been re balanced. In an effort to make the fights more challenging. Enemies will now do more damage to the player. 

That's all for now. More changes shall be coming as always. The next patch will hopefully include more big changes! Cheers! 

Baq

ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch 0.1 In
notes.notes:
Hi! 

Thanks for the feedback! Really appreciated! We just updated the game with a day 1 patch.

1).  You now have the ability to block with the "R" button therefore giving more variety to the gameplay. 

2). Health now has a 15 second cool down period. Hopefully this will make the fights more interesting. 

3).  There was a bug which cut the final boss fight short. It has been fixed. My sincerest apologies.

More patches will be on the way to continue to make the game better.

Thanks again for the feedback and hope you guys enjoy the new changes. 

Baq﻿
